# Security

These steps run as root on a new server. We take every report seriously.

## Report a problem

- Email security@eeploi.com.
- Do not open a public issue or pull request for a security problem.
- Tell us the commit, the file and step, what you found and how to reproduce it.

## What happens next

- We confirm we got your report within 3 working days.
- We keep your report private until a fix is out.
- We credit you in the fix, unless you ask us not to.

## Supported versions

Only `main` gets fixes. A server keeps the steps it was built with; eeploi records which commit built it.
